transactions.desc: The Rays designated Martin for assignment Thursday.
The Rays optioned Williams to Triple-A Durham on Thursday.
The Rays optioned Grove to Triple-A Durham on Thursday.
The Rays recalled Scholtens from Triple-A Durham on Thursday.
The Twins activated Buxton (hip) from the 10-day injured list Thursday.
Richardson cleared waivers Thursday and elected free agency, Jack Stern of BrewerFanatic.com reports.
The Tigers recalled Cruz from Triple-A Toledo on Thursday.
The Blue Jays recalled Estrada from Triple-A Buffalo on Thursday.

Godbout (hand) has gone 0-for-9 with three strikeouts over his first two games at Double-A Portland since being assigned to the affiliate Tuesday after being reinstated from High-A Greenville's 60-day injured list.
The Pirates optioned Sisk to Triple-A Indianapolis on Thursday.
The Pirates recalled Mattson from Triple-A Indianapolis on Thursday.
The Pirates recalled Brannigan from Triple-A Indianapolis on Thursday.
The Red Sox recalled Weissert from Triple-A Worcester on Thursday, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
Mateo signed a major-league contract with the Rays on Wednesday, Francys Romero of BeisbolFR.com reports.
Walcott (concussion) was reinstated from the 7-day injured list at Double-A Frisco on Wednesday, Shawn McFarland of The Dallas Morning News reports.
The Dodgers recalled Knack from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Wednesday.
The Dodgers optioned Halvorsen to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Wednesday.
Curtis (side) was reinstated from Triple-A Indianapolis' 7-day injured list Wednesday, Dominic Campbell of SI.com reports.
The Tigers selected Julks' contract from Triple-A Toledo on Wednesday.
The Tigers designated Watson for assignment Wednesday.
The Padres reinstated Morgan (knee) from the 15-day injured list and optioned him to Triple-A El Paso on Wednesday.
The Tigers optioned Diaz to Triple-A Toledo on Wednesday, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.
The Tigers activated De Jesus (personal) from the paternity leave list Wednesday, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.
The Rockies recalled Amador from Triple-A Albuquerque on Wednesday.
The Rockies reinstated Criswell (shoulder) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday and optioned him to Triple-A Albuquerque.
The Blue Jays claimed Sewald off waivers from the Diamondbacks on Wednesday.
The Boston Red Sox traded OF Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles.
The Athletics recalled Rom from Triple-A Las Vegas on Wednesday.
The Athletics optioned Tur to Triple-A Las Vegas on Wednesday.
The Athletics recalled Juenger from Triple-A Las Vegas on Wednesday.
